bottleneck.description: #4 global 300mm silicon wafer supplier (~12% revenue share) inside a 5-player oligopoly (Shin-Etsu/SUMCO/GlobalWafers/Siltronic/SK Siltron) controlling ~85% of 300mm capacity.

dependency.key_customers: TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Intel, Infineon, STMicro (memory + logic + power)
dependency.key_suppliers: Polysilicon producers (Wacker, OCI, GCL), quartz crucibles, slurry/CMP consumables, specialty gases

editorial.notes: Siltronic sits in the same consolidated wafer oligopoly anchored at MEDIUM for Shin-Etsu — qualification cycles for prime 300mm wafers run multi-year and capital intensity is severe, but customers can dual-source across Shin-Etsu/SUMCO/GlobalWafers/SK Siltron. 2026 guidance flagged mid-single-digit revenue decline and net debt rose to EUR 837M on heavy capex; management noted peers being 'extremely vocal' about 200mm headwinds. Not a sole-source choke; calibration vs the Shin-Etsu MEDIUM anchor implies a smaller-share oligopoly participant should also rate MEDIUM rather than higher.
